title: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles
summary: Establishes the FASB Accounting Standards Codification as the single source of authoritative U.S. GAAP for nongovernmental entities, governing the structure, amendment process, and hierarchy of US GAAP.
description: ASC 105 establishes the FASB Accounting Standards Codification (the Codification) as the single source of authoritative U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) for nongovernmental entities.
